__
 
• Add "**but**" as a preposition before "**to report**" to correct the sentence grammatically.
 
• **But **is used as a preposition for joining ideas when the second is different.
 
• The word “**but**' is considered a preposition that means “other than.”
 
• The sentence says the only option left to the soldier was to inform their commander of the loss.

• The correct answer is option 4.

 

The correct sentence is: *The soldiers had no choice but to__ report the loss to their commander.*

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Such problems include difficulty in implementing decisions, providing social security to everyone and ensuring employment.

B. This is because almost all countries face problems related to their population.

C. The most crucial aspect of the problem is population pressure.

D. The population explosion is an important issue these days.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "DBAC"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage. 
 
• Statement D is the opening sentence of the passage as it gives a brief introduction to the major concern of current population growth.
 
• Statement B is the second sentence of the passage which explains that it is due to the fact that practically all countries suffer population-related issues.
 
• Statement A is the third sentence of the passage which explains problems such as difficulty in executing decisions, providing social security to everybody, and assuring employment are examples of such issues.
 
• Statement C is the last sentence of the passage which shows that population pressure is the most critical part of the problem.

Hence, the correct sequence is D, B, A, C

The correct answer is option 3.

The correct passage is: ***D**. The population explosion is an important issue these days. **B**. This is because almost all countries face problems related to their population. **A**. Such problems include difficulty in implementing decisions, providing social security to everyone and ensuring employment. **C**. The most crucial aspect of the problem is population pressure.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Radha said, “Why didn’t he forward his petition to me?”

options.text: Radha enquired why he had not forwarded his petition to her.
Radha enquired why he has not forwarded his petition to her.
Radha enquired why had he not forwarded his petition to her.
Radha enquired why he had not forward his petition to her.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Radha enquired why he had not forwarded his petition to her.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in direct speech and we need to convert it to indirect speech.
 
• When we change a direct speech to an indirect speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" is changed to "enquired" in the indirect speech.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") are removed to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is removed in the indirect speech.
 
• The **question mark (?)** is omitted in the indirect speech.
 
• The first word of the indirect speech should be in capital letters.
 
• The **simple past tense** (did not forward) in the direct speech changes to the **past perfect tense** (had not forwarded) in the indirect speech.
 
• The first person pronoun "**me**" changed to the third person pronoun "**her**" in the indirect speech.
 
 
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer which follows the rules properly.

 

Hence, indirect speech is - *Radha enquired why he had not forwarded his petition to her.*

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.**

Electrolytes like

P. important for balancing the water in your body

Q. are present in the body’s fluids and are

R. are electrically charged minerals that

S. sodium, potassium, chloride and magnesium
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: SRQP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Here, the first part of the whole sentence is already given.
 
• After that 'S' should be the best fit to keep the sentence meaningful. The first word of the 'S' part is "sodium". So, if we connect it with the first one, the sentence will be like "Electrolytes like sodium, potassium, chloride and magnesium."
 
• Then 'R' follows 'S' to keep the sentence meaningful. The sentence will be like "...sodium, potassium, chloride and magnesium are electrically charged minerals" which means "Minerals with electrical charges include sodium, potassium, chloride, and magnesium."
 
• After that 'Q' follows '**R**' and connecting the parts will be like "...minerals that are present in the body’s fluids.."
 
• Lastly 'P' should be placed as it is the closing statement as it is defining the importance of all these minerals.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4, i.e. SRQP.

 

**Let us look at the whole sentence after rearranging it:** *Electrolytes like sodium, potassium, chloride and magnesium are electrically charged minerals that are present in the body’s fluids and are important for balancing the water in your body.*

• The Simple Past Tense in the passive voice has the following structure: Object+ was/were + V3 + by + subject__
 
• The Simple Past Tense in the active voice has the following structure: __Subject + V2+ object__
 
• Example - 
 
 
• Passive voice - *He was saved by me.*

• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.
